responsibility: This file implements per-expression and per-statement warning suppression bookkeeping in GCC. It reads and writes the no-warning bits on trees and gimple statements, consults and updates the location-keyed nowarn_map that records suppression by option code, answers whether a particular warning is suppressed at a given IR node, and copies suppression state across newly created trees or statements. Its role is fine-grained diagnostic-control infrastructure used when transformations need to preserve or adjust warning disposition metadata.
